neighbours.label: The 'cri' token inside split scribe-words (indes|cri|bable, trans|cri|ber), vs 'cribe/cribed' pieces and whole-token describe-words
fire: The view from the summit at dawn was simply indescribable.
She hired two transcribers to type up the oral history tapes.
There was an indescribable smell coming from the old cellar.
Each of the transcribers worked from the same audio file.
The relief he felt when the boat came into view was indescribable.
The court transcriber read back the witness's last answer.
The music filled the hall with an indescribably gentle sound.
Volunteer transcribers have digitized thousands of old letters.
quiet: The view from the summit at dawn was simply breathtaking.
She hired two assistants to transcribe the oral history tapes.

The court reporter read back the witness's last answer.
